description: Walk the connections of one party (from mRAG_graph_overview) — who/what it is linked to, with the edge type, how many times observed, and when. Answers 'who is connected to X, and how'. Depth is hard-clamped to 2 hops and breadth to 200 server-side. Owner-scoped.

depth.description: Hops to walk. Hard-clamped to 2 server-side. Default 1.

limit.description: Max neighbours to return. Clamped to 200. Default 50.

party_id.description: The party whose connections to walk (a party_id from mRAG_graph_overview).

name: mRAG_graph_neighbors
